subject: CAIQ control response consolidation + runtime evidence access
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@nebulahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Myers <jake@nebulahealth.com>, Nebula Health Security <controls@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ mapping + runtime log samples for pre-contract review

Jonas —

Thanks again for taking time last week. As part of our procurement security review we need a CAIQ response package that maps Redwood's controls to CSA/CAIQ questions for the services in scope (Hosted API + Dedicated). Two asks to help us complete the deck by 1/22: 

1) A mapping file (CSV/Excel) indicating your control IDs, short rationale, and links to supporting artifacts.
2) Runtime evidence samples for a small set of controls related to key management, tenant isolation, and telemetry (we only need samples, not full production exports). 

Can you confirm who on your side will own the artifacts and whether there is a secure upload mechanism (S3 presigned, secure portal, DocuSign/Share)? We prefer a single intake point and a short runbook describing what each artifact represents.

Thanks — appreciate a quick TOC and rough timeline.

Sophie Park
Security & Compliance Manager
Nebula Health

PS — linking our vendor intake: https://nebulahealth.com/vendor-security/records/CAIQ-1283

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Jake Myers <jake@nebulahealth.com>, Nebula Health Security <controls@nebulahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + runtime log samples for pre-contract review

Sophie —

Appreciate the clarity. We can deliver the mapping and a small evidence bundle by 1/19. Proposed plan: 

• Deliverable 1 (by 1/15): CAIQ mapping workbook with per-question assertions and short rationale plus an assertion-to-control id column. Attached: CAIQ_initial_map.xlsx (draft).
• Deliverable 2 (by 1/19): Evidence bundle (sample runtime logs, KMS rotation proof, tenant isolation trace) uploaded to a secure intake portal. We will provide a short runbook: evidence-access-instructions.md.

Owner assignment: Kim Park (cc'd) will lead packaging and artifact validation; David Kim will extract sample logs and redact tenant-identifying metadata; Marissa Cole will coordinate DocuSign/access if legal signatures are needed.

Upload options: we can provide a temporary S3 signed link or your preferred portal. I also pushed a secure folder to our shared Drive; link below.

Would you like the mapping as a single workbook or split by domain (network/identity/ops)? We usually deliver a single workbook with tabs per domain unless you request otherwise.

Jonas Weber
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAIQ_initial_map.xlsx; evidence-access-instructions.md
Shared link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCAIQ-nebula-evidence

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Nebula CAIQ — artifact triage and redaction guidelines

Team —

Action items following Sophie’s ask (timeline in parenthesis):

1) Kimberly: finalize the CAIQ workbook (tab-per-domain) and certify the rationale column. Use the attached draft as a baseline. (ETA 1/15)
2) David: pull the runtime samples requested: KMS rotation logs (kms-rotation entries), tenant isolation trace (kv-cache eviction and routing logs), and telemetry excerpts (token-level latency traces). REDACT customer IDs and IPs — replace with pseudonyms. Deliver to secure staging S3 with encryption at rest. (ETA 1/17)
3) Marissa: prepare the intake method and minimal legal ack (DocuSign link or secure portal). Confirm whether Nebula prefers DocuSign or direct upload. (ETA 1/16)

Quoting Sophie for context: "We prefer a single intake point and a short runbook describing what each artifact represents." Keep notes brief in the workbook: artifact name, what it proves, retention window, and point of contact.

If any control needs a longer narrative we can add a 'control note' column. Flag anything that may need product team sign-off.

Jonas

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Nebula CAIQ — artifact triage and redaction guidelines

Jonas / team —

Quick update: I reviewed the draft mapping and added a new column for 'evidence sample id' so each assertion points to a discrete artifact. I attached two stubs to speed review: kms-rotation-proof.pdf (redacted proof of KMS key rotation workflow) and log-sample-list.txt (index of the runtime sample files we plan to stage).

Notes / questions: 
- For KMS proof, we'll provide a signed rotation manifest plus a small excerpt of rotation audit logs (redacted).
- For telemetry traces, we will include anonymized token-latency samples (5-minute windows) rather than full streams — that should satisfy their request without exposing PII.
- Do we need to include our quantization/serving kernel selection notes as evidence for control CCM-3.6? Sophie, if Nebula wants that, we can add a short narrative.

Attachments: kms-rotation-proof.pdf; log-sample-list.txt

Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@nebulahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Myers <jake@nebulahealth.com>, Nebula Health Security <controls@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control response consolidation + runtime evidence access

Jonas / Kimberly —

This looks good, thank you. The proposed timeline and the artifact index meet our needs. Two quick asks before we close the intake: 

1) Please upload the evidence bundle to the shared intake portal and post the signed S3 presigned URLs to the Drive index. We will use your S3 links to pull artifacts into our secure review environment.
2) Can you add a one-page narrative for any control where the mapping is "compensating control" rather than a direct match? Helps our reviewers accept the deviation.

If you can get those uploaded by EOD Monday (1/19) we'll wrap internal approvals on our side and schedule a brief follow-up call if necessary. Appreciated.

Best,
Sophie Park
Security & Compliance Manager
Nebula Health
